description: This file defines the class SugarFieldHtml, a specialized field class in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework responsible for handling HTML fields in detail, edit, and search views. It includes methods for retrieving and sanitizing HTML content for display.

classes.name: SugarFieldHtml
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase, providing HTML-specific handling for display and editing fields, ensuring HTML content is cleaned and properly encoded.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares sanitized HTML for display in a detail view.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares sanitized HTML for editing view, enabling safe editing of HTML content.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares sanitized HTML for the search view.

methods.name: getVardefValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value from vardef, defaulting or encoding as necessary, ensuring safe HTML handling.
